source.title: A Product of Faith
source.objective: Receive the Seal of the Dawn.
source.progress:
I shudder to think of the horrors you've faced to come this far. You're an inspiration to the Argent Dawn, and I can only pray that you continue to aid us in this manner.

Bring me more Remnants of Valor, and I'll empower your seal. I believe there's a way to go before you realize your potential.
source.completion:
Well done, <name>. To purify the fallen would be a worthy endeavor in and of itself, even if no reward were promised.

Of course, that's not the case for you! Take your newly-empowered seal.
